proof: Fixture transport and selection checks; live invented-data smoke receipts are recorded separately. No independent provider ranking or tool containment is claimed.; AGY replies with missing/unknown init.model are refused before draft/plan use, with regression cases for missing init, null, empty and unknown identity.; Azure refusals carry a closed-vocabulary reason_code and whitelisted diagnostics (finish reason, safe observed model, unexpected field names, schema path/keyword, content length, HTTP status, reported counters) that the runner re-reduces into model_call_failed events without charging usage or lifting the unknown-usage guard; canary tests show no provider text is copied.
title: Explicit AGY model families alongside Muse and local inference
